<policy>
Refunds are available within 14 days of purchase for annual plans, and within 48 hours for monthly plans. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days.
</policy>

Question: I bought an annual plan 10 days ago, can I get a refund?

request.system: You answer questions about Acme's refund policy using ONLY the policy text provided. If the policy does not cover the question, reply exactly: NOT_COVERED. Keep answers under 60 words.

response.text: Yes, you can get a refund since the 14-day refund period applies to annual plans. Refunds are issued to the original payment method within 5 business days.
